text: Supports native vector search (vector database) since v1.2.0
quote: Being a vector database, Orama allows you to perform vector search natively.

text: Hybrid search fuses full-text and vector results in a single query
quote: Hybrid search is an Orama feature that allows you to perform full-text and vector search in one unique query, combining the results to get the best of both worlds.

text: Lets users filter search results by category, price range, and other attributes
quote: users can filter their search results by various criteria, such as category, price range, or other attributes

text: Generates facets at search time based on the schema to narrow results
quote: Facets are a powerful tool for filtering and narrowing down search results on the Orama search engine.

text: AnswerSession feature delivers ChatGPT-like conversational Q&A experiences on your website
quote: we introduced a new feature called **AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website.

text: Turns a question into a direct answer with the supporting sources cited
quote: turns a question into a straight answer with the sources behind it

text: Secure Proxy relays AnswerSession queries to OpenAI so the API key is never exposed client-side
quote: AnswerSession** that allows you to perform ChatGPT-like experiences on your website. It uses a free feature from Orama Cloud called **Secure Proxy** to proxy your queries to the OpenAI API, so you don't need to worry about sharing the API k

text: A plugin auto-generates embeddings for documents at insert and search time
quote: This plugin generates embeddings for your documents at insert and search time, allowing you to perform vector and hybrid searches on your documents.

text: Offers on-premise deployment of the Orama Cloud context server on your own infrastructure
quote: We offer on-premise support for Orama Cloud, allowing you to deploy the context server on your own infrastructure.

text: Every Orama Cloud project ships with an automatically configured MCP server for agent access
quote: Every Orama Cloud project comes with an MCP server that is automatically configured to interact with your project's data.

text: Lets you interact with your data from AI interfaces like ChatGPT and Cursor
quote: you'll be able to interact with your data from different AI interfaces, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and many other

text: Orama Cloud lets you choose which search algorithm best suits your needs
quote: Orama Cloud gives you the flexibility to choose the search algorithm that best suits your needs.

text: A data source identifies a specific set of documents from a single origin
quote: A data source identifies a specific set of documents, ideally coming from a single origin.

text: Open-source search library free to add fast, relevant search to your app
quote: The open-source search library. Add fast, relevant search to your own application at no cost.

text: Stemming and tokenization supported in 30 languages
quote: Stemming and tokenization in 30 languages

text: Nested JSON properties are supported natively in the schema
quote: Orama supports nested properties natively. Just add them as you would typically do in any JavaScript object

text: insertMultiple lets you bulk-insert large numbers of documents without blocking the event loop
quote: Inserting a large number of documents in a loop could potentially block the event loop. Instead `insertMultiple` handles this case better.

text: Open-source APIs mirror Orama Cloud APIs, enabling easy migration between Cloud and OSS
quote: The APIs are designed to be as close as possible to the **Orama Cloud** APIs, so you can easily migrate your projects from **Orama Cloud** to **Orama Open Source** and vice-versa.

text: Officially supports JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Rust SDKs
quote: Orama Cloud officially supports the following SDKs: - JavaScript/TypeScript - Python - Rust

text: You can split data across multiple data sources based on differing update schedules
quote: you can put data that will be updated frequently in a single data source (let's call it `docs`), and put data that follows a different update schedule in another data source

text: A project groups multiple data sources for RAG, search, or other retrieval use cases

quote: Full-text search - Vector search - Hybrid search - AI-powered NLP search
